summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P 100 Equal Weight ETF (EQWL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 100 Equal Weighted index. The fund tracks the an equally-weighted index composed of the 100 largest companies in the US equity markets. EQWL was launched on Dec 1, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: EQWL is an equity ETF with a total of 103 individual holdings. The top holdings are Advanced Micro Devices stock at 1.22%, Intel at 1.16%, Meta Platforms at 1.16%, Intuitive Surgical at 1.15%, and QUALCOMM at 1.15%.
